runtime_evidence.rationale: Mobile 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth now 360 (was 402 — 42px table clip); comparison table scrolls in a labelled focusable region; desktop screenshot read; console clean except environmental fonts request.

openQuestions.title: Add an honest IWA prerequisite panel
openQuestions.detail: A short 'how you would actually run this' checklist (IWA install, controlled-frame permission, kiosk policy) would make the unsupported-in-browser state more actionable.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Mobile-clip fix: the four-column embedding-mechanisms comparison table forced 42px of page overflow at 360px; it now scrolls inside a keyboard-focusable overflow-x:auto region and the page measures exactly 360 wide. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
